text:
Hannah Lee: dropping two directions for first-run: a compact onboarding rail (right edge, persistent) vs a visual tile panel (center-left) with a short checklist / starter concierge. comps in Figma: https://fig.redwood/onboard/rail_v1 and https://fig.redwood/onboard/tiles_v1. thoughts?
Tomas (Design): rail = low-friction, keeps context. tiles + checklist = better for discovering curated samples and templates. concern: tiles could dominate smaller screens.
Alyssa (UX): tiles helpful for new orgs who need inspiration. the checklist flow is nice: 3 steps (connect repo, try sample, set env) and shows progress sparkline. rail is better for returning users.
Noel (Eng): engineering note: rail is client-only and lighter. tiles require image assets + SSR fallback to avoid CLS. also need per-user opt-out for both.
Priyanka (Metrics): metric ask: we'll track onboard.impression, onboard.cta_click, onboard.checklist_start, onboard.checklist_complete, project.create. baseline conversion for current banner is 6% create within 48h. target +3pt.
Mason (a11y): accessibility nits up front: rail needs a visible focus ring and skip link to main content; tiles must have semantic headings, image alt text, and use role="list"/"listitem" for screen readers. color contrast on tile CTA is 3.2:1 now 1 needs to hit 4.5:1. also ensure the checklist updates are announced via aria-live polite.
Tomas (Design): noted on contrast and aria-live. quick copy options — experimenting with benefit-led headlines:
```
Option 1: "Spin up a working sample in under a minute"
CTA: "Launch sample"
Option 2: "Start a template and customize"
CTA: "Use template"
Option 3: "Follow a quick setup checklist"
CTA: "Start checklist"
```
Alyssa (UX): prefer Option 1 for tiles (curiosity), Option 3 for the checklist flow, Option 2 for the rail where we want lower churn.
Noel (Eng): my vote: rail -> CTA "Use template" (short), tiles -> "Launch sample". checklist -> "Start checklist" so telemetry is clean.
Priyanka (Metrics): propose experiment split: 40% rail, 40% tiles+checklist, 20% control. power calc: need ~2.5k new accounts per arm for detecting a 3pp uplift in creates.
FlagService: created experiment exp.onboard.rail_vs_tiles.v1 with rollout 40/40/20.
Mason (a11y): i'll run keyboard + NVDA smoke on staging once builds are up. checklist updates should have aria-live status so screen readers read progress like "Step 2 of 3 completed".
Hannah Lee: action items: 1) Tomas update colors + focus tokens and add aria-live annotations 2) Noel stub feature flag and persist dismiss pref 3) Priyanka wire events and dashboards 4) Mason run a11y checklist after build 5) Alyssa draft microcopy for checklist steps.
Noel (Eng): implementation notes: tiles will lazy-load images with placeholder, server will record dismiss preference, and we'll add a small telemetry ping for partial checklist progress. ticket created: #ONB-344.
Alyssa (UX): drafting checklist microcopy now. example: "1) Launch sample, 2) Run quick test, 3) Deploy to preview". will add copy variants in Figma.
Priyanka (Metrics): I'll add funnels and a pre-built dashboard: /drive/onboard/exp_rail_tiles_kpis. will share expected sample-size and ETA for 2-week read.
Mason (a11y): quick checklist i'll run: tab order, screen reader announce, focus restore on dismiss, contrast, aria-live. posting results here.
Hannah Lee: thanks team 60 we'll reconvene after 7 days of data to decide which pattern to ship wider. :rocket:
